title: Enforce the portfolio resource governor on real heavy workloads
completion_criteria: Finish real resource-governor enforcement, not dashboard-only telemetry. Keep protected control-plane capacity for zCloud/zSSH; enforce one shared heavy pool across FTMO research/backtests, HaxLab training and LightUp lab bursts; keep bounded build capacity for Supa/RaiseAI/uLab technical jobs. Wire acquire/renew/release with finally/always cleanup into every relevant self-hosted workflow/service entrypoint. Apply safe systemd/cgroup CPU and memory controls or equivalent bounded process controls using the declared project contracts, without exposing secrets or interrupting already-running critical jobs. Add deterministic contention, expiry, crash-recovery and no-starvation tests plus a live VPS concurrency canary proving two heavy projects cannot run simultaneously while control-plane work remains responsive. Completion requires merged code, exact-head green CI, production deploy evidence and a live governor status receipt.

title: Finish the unified project runtime contract cutover
completion_criteria: Make project-contracts.json the single canonical runtime contract for every active project: autonomy mode, auto-start, queue mode, lane profile, AI worker cap, compute class/pool, soft CPU/memory budget and protected status. Remove or demote duplicated hard-coded runtime truth in server.py/enhancements.py/autonomy-policy.json after compatibility proof, and extend fail-closed config validation so a project cannot start when registry and contract disagree or a contract is missing. Completion requires all active projects covered, migration/backward-compatibility tests, green regression suite and production evidence that /api/autonomy, allocator caps and resource telemetry are contract-driven.

title: Finish evidence-driven project state receipts across all execution paths
completion_criteria: Complete the receipt rollout end-to-end. Every material worker/CI/VPS completion path must emit a project_state_receipt with project, phase, last material action, canonical commit, CI/runtime result, blocker if any, next executable gate, timestamp and machine-readable evidence. zCloud dashboard/API must prefer the latest valid receipt for phase/next-step while retaining registry fallback when no receipt exists. Backfill at least one current receipt for every active project from verified canonical evidence. Add regression tests for stale projects.json state being superseded by receipts, malformed receipts failing closed, and receipt persistence across restart. Completion requires merged code, green exact-head CI, production deployment, and live /api/status evidence showing receipt-backed state for all active projects.

title: Research and codify the current OpenAI plugin submission contract
completion_criteria: RESEARCH_FIRST. Use current primary OpenAI plugin/MCP documentation before changing implementation. Write or update a dated research artifact in Zennay/zSSH covering package format, public review flow, organization verification, api.apps permissions, global-data-residency requirement, universal-vs-template MCP URL rules, OAuth discovery/client identification, tool annotations, UI/CSP expectations, exact reviewer materials, and submission error classes. Record source URLs, uncertainties, and engineering decisions. Then implement at least one machine-enforced validator/build/test change that makes zSSH conform to the researched contract. Completion requires both the research artifact and green automated evidence; research-only or coding-without-research does not count.

title: Research, decide, and implement the public universal-endpoint architecture
completion_criteria: RESEARCH_FIRST. Research the current OpenAI universal remote-MCP endpoint requirement and template-URL restrictions plus MCP/OAuth security guidance. Compare at least three viable self-hosted zSSH connection models and document an ADR with threat boundaries, data flow, failure modes, privacy implications, and why the selected design keeps command execution on the user's paired target and never stores users' SSH private keys in a central relay. Then implement the next production-grade architecture slice and tests. Completion requires ADR + code/config + deterministic tests.

title: Build the simple zSSH connect website and pairing experience
completion_criteria: RESEARCH_FIRST. Research secure connection/onboarding patterns and the current OpenAI plugin linking requirements, then build a small polished responsive zSSH website for connecting a Linux target. It must clearly show what zSSH does, connection state, target label, OAuth/account state, pairing request/status, local approval instructions, revoke/disconnect, and a safe install/setup path without exposing bearer tokens, SSH keys, or secrets in URLs/logs. Keep the UI visually simple and trustworthy on mobile and desktop. Add CSP/security headers, accessibility basics, failure/loading states, and automated UI/route tests.

title: Research and implement explicit scoped sudo capability grants
completion_criteria: RESEARCH_FIRST. Research least-privilege sudoers patterns, systemd hardening, command argument hazards, and safe privilege delegation for remote agents. Implement an owner-controlled local capability-grant flow so sudo access can be deliberately enabled for specific zSSH capabilities without granting an unrestricted NOPASSWD shell. Include generated/validated sudoers snippets or an equivalent policy boundary, local confirmation, clear effective-permission display, revocation/rollback, audit events, fail-closed defaults, and tests proving ungranted privileged actions fail. Never commit secrets.

title: Research and finish production OAuth 2.1 for the public plugin
completion_criteria: RESEARCH_FIRST. Re-check current OpenAI MCP OAuth requirements including protected-resource metadata, authorization-server metadata, Authorization Code + PKCE S256, resource propagation, CIMD/DCR/predefined-client options, per-tool securitySchemes, issuer/audience/scope validation, and reviewer-account constraints. Document the selected provider/setup and then implement missing production OAuth pieces, negative-path tests, and deployment configuration without placing credentials in source control.

title: Finish the portable plugin package and reviewer materials
completion_criteria: RESEARCH_FIRST. Verify the latest OpenAI portable Agent Plugins package schema and submission field reference. Make the zSSH submission ZIP machine-valid with root plugin.json and the correct MCP mapping, current branding/legal/support metadata, release notes, onboarding material where useful, and exactly five positive plus three negative MCP review cases with expected tools/behavior. Add validators that reject stale or incomplete review metadata. Prepare a reviewer-safe demo fixture and recording checklist; never place reviewer credentials in the ZIP.

title: Threat-model and red-team the public zSSH release candidate
completion_criteria: RESEARCH_FIRST. Update a concrete threat model using current MCP/plugin security guidance, then implement adversarial regression coverage for OAuth confusion, cross-user pairing, replay/revocation, path traversal/symlink boundaries, unsafe sudo capability expansion, prompt/tool misuse, secret leakage, rate/abuse behavior, UI origin/CSP issues, and private-profile tools leaking into the public scan. Fix findings and produce green CI evidence; a report without fixes/tests is not completion.

title: Drive zSSH to a submission-ready public ChatGPT plugin release
completion_criteria: Treat this as the final ship-ready gate, not a generic incremental task. Before any mutation, read the canonical zSSH managed M5 handoff (issue #159 or its successor) and classify execution_state plus blocking_gate. If execution_state is external_input_only, do not invent zSSH repository hardening, widen auth/tool scope, or create unrelated release PRs. Work only on the exact canonical external/control-plane transition: secret-safe provider credential readiness, guarded DNS publication, or the existing zCloud VPS gateway/ingress lanes. Never copy secret values into source, logs, artifacts, issues, or Notion. When the handoff becomes provider_execution or advances to a later lane, execute only that canonical lane from exact zSSH main and preserve immutable run provenance. Re-read current primary OpenAI submission docs as needed, then prove the complete zSSH path: stable public HTTPS MCP endpoint, production OAuth, universal endpoint behavior, connect website, target pairing/revocation, explicit scoped sudo grants, public/private capability separation, privacy/terms/support, current tool metadata scan, five positive and three negative review cases, reviewer fixture, domain challenge support, deterministic plugin ZIP, and production end-to-end probe. Resolve automatable gaps only when they correspond to the active canonical gate and record exact workflow/run evidence and artifact hashes. If a provider/dashboard-only identity, credential, or reviewer action remains, surface that exact action without speculative code churn.

title: Harden the permanent VPS-first deploy lane
completion_criteria: Implement and validate the next reliability increment for the permanent zCloud VPS-first deploy lane, keeping rollback/LKG/canary protections and avoiding temporary cross-project bridges. Completion requires code/workflow changes plus green automated evidence.

title: Implement continuous portfolio queue replenishment
completion_criteria: Implement a permanent queue-refill mechanism for the SQLite portfolio_queue source of truth so substantial executable work is continuously added while safe project work exists. Refill after completion/block/drop and during scheduler ticks when runnable inventory falls below its target; derive concrete next work from current project state/HQ/handoff and existing claims. Prevent duplicate/conflicting write scopes, micro-task spam, read-only/status-only items and human-gated work from entering the runnable queue. Preserve project priorities and worker diversity. Completion requires production code/config changes plus regression tests proving the queue replenishes repeatedly without duplicate spam and does not run dry under normal worker turnover.

title: Implement automatic worker lanes from project type and backlog
completion_criteria: Implement a deterministic lane generator that derives non-overlapping execution lanes from project type, current backlog and claims, with regression tests proving it avoids duplicate/conflicting write scopes.

title: Implement evidence-based project telemetry adapters
completion_criteria: Implement the adapter interface and at least one real project adapter so zCloud can distinguish latest/current/best validated progress using timestamped sources. Add tests and preserve generic fallback for projects without adapters.

title: Build the central structured worker event stream
completion_criteria: Implement structured worker/task/validation/resource events with correlation IDs and a central read path for dashboard/debugging. Include migration-safe storage and regression tests.

title: Harden browser worker conversation and duplicate-send reliability
completion_criteria: Implement a concrete browser-runner reliability increment around deterministic conversation identity, reconnect, generation-boundary detection or duplicate-send prevention, with regression tests and no impact on unrelated tabs.

title: Keep FTMO autonomous progression healthy and self-recovering
completion_criteria: Do not manually act as the normal generation loop. FTMO research progression belongs to the persistent self-hosted runtime. Only intervene when that runtime cannot self-advance: fix the concrete code/config/service/data-gate cause, preserve provider provenance and sealed outcome boundaries, then prove the persistent runtime resumes autonomous safe progression with deterministic workflow/runtime evidence.

title: Make Raise AI gateway deployment and live smoke verification repeatable
completion_criteria: Implement the next idempotent deploy/restart/live-smoke automation increment for Raise AI so merged gateway code can be proven live without manual shell sequences. Keep secrets server-side and add regression/workflow evidence.

title: Implement the next scoped smart-home connector increment
completion_criteria: Implement a bounded, testable connector increment for the smart_home route without exposing broad arbitrary execution. Add authorization/failure-path tests and keep the existing zCloud/current-info/AI routing intact.

title: Build the Supa production mobile UI foundation
completion_criteria: Implement a material mobile-first production UI/state increment in the canonical Supa app, preserving the validated planner-first and budget-first flow. Completion requires code plus automated build/test evidence.

title: Connect the Supa planner flow to real app state
completion_criteria: Implement typed state and persistence through the planner flow so onboarding/budget/planning decisions survive navigation and can drive downstream grocery/recipe logic. Add tests for the critical state transitions.

title: Build supermarket HTML snapshot scrapers and selector extraction
completion_criteria: Build real supermarket web scrapers from captured source HTML, not invented selectors. Select the first two target supermarkets for the M1 data-feasibility lane; download representative real public product/search/offer pages and store sanitized/versioned HTML fixtures with source URL and captured-at provenance; inspect those fixtures to derive resilient selectors or embedded-data extraction paths for product identity, name, price, unit/pack size, offer mechanics and availability; implement source-specific adapters/scrapers against the captured HTML; add parser regression tests using the real snapshots plus explicit failure/staleness handling. Re-fetch live pages through the VPS execution lane to prove at least one end-to-end extraction per target source when legally/technically accessible. Do not fabricate HTML or selectors and do not bypass authentication, anti-bot controls, paywalls or terms restrictions.

title: Implement the next recipe and offer engine slice
completion_criteria: Implement a deterministic production slice that converts grocery/offer data into planner-ready recipe or basket choices with explicit savings data, typed boundaries and regression tests.

title: Build the next Closed-Loop Evaluation Arena v2 implementation increment
completion_criteria: Make a material code/config/workflow change that advances Closed-Loop Evaluation Arena v2 on the current HaxLab implementation branch, with deterministic fixed-seed rollout behavior and green automated tests/workflow evidence. Read-only inspection, status, audit, checklist or documentation-only work does not complete this item.

title: Implement the frozen multi-source evaluation suite v2
completion_criteria: Implement versioned tooling/config that selects and freezes multiple disjoint replay sources with deterministic seeds, provenance and regression coverage; produce a reproducible evaluation manifest/artifact and green tests. Merely inspecting or describing candidate sources is not completion.

title: Implement guard-independence as a mandatory Arena v2 promotion gate
completion_criteria: Add or complete executable guard-intervention/role-leash/recovery-dependency metrics and fail-closed promotion logic, with regression tests proving a guard-dependent challenger cannot pass. Requires code plus test/workflow evidence; audit-only work does not count.

title: Implement versioned rollout/recovery dataset generation
completion_criteria: Implement a deterministic versioned pipeline that persists model-visited failures/recovery states separately from raw human evidence, with provenance, idempotent reruns and automated tests or bounded workflow evidence. Read-only analysis is insufficient.

title: Advance the LightUp safe assessment MVP
completion_criteria: Make a material implementation change that advances LightUp's authorization-first safe assessment MVP, with code or configuration plus automated tests or reproducible CI evidence. Keep the existing authorization and scope guardrails intact. Read-only analysis or documentation-only work does not complete this item.

title: Harden zGuard and zBrowse runtime
completion_criteria: Make a material code, configuration, or test change in Zennay/zGuard that improves browser runtime reliability, privacy, recovery, popup handling, or the TV-friendly UX. Completion requires deterministic tests and VPS workflow evidence when runtime validation is needed.
